translations.web: Prepare your work outside, and get your fields ready. Afterwards, build your house.
translations.bsb: Complete your outdoor work and prepare your field; after that, you may build your house.
translations.kjv: Prepare thy work without, and make it fit for thyself in the field; and afterwards build thine house.
translations.asv: Prepare thy work without, And make it ready for thee in the field; And afterwards build thy house.
